thresholds.note: Hierarchical overrides: profile → group → node. The most specific scope wins.
thresholds.explainer: ICMP liveness (node up/down) alerts automatically — no rule needed. Rules here add metric thresholds on top: each is evaluated live on every matching poll sample, with the most-specific scope winning. Warning/critical bounds and a dwell (consecutive samples before it commits, anti-flap) are per rule.

thresholds.emptySub: Add a metric threshold scoped to a profile, group, or node.

addModal.dwellTitle: Dwell: consecutive readings that must breach before the alert fires
addModal.boundsHint: Warn / crit / dwell are optional. Dwell is how many consecutive readings must cross the bound before the alert fires — higher values suppress flapping (rapid on/off alerts).
